title: John Mack's abductees and the double identity

tellings.quote: John Mack's talking about all these abductees and they're talking about being in a fear state obviously the first time the onlogical shock you see a gray being in your bedroom or something. Then he took it one step deeper with you and he said but often the abductee starts to identify with the the being.

plain: People who say aliens took them often start in terror, the "ontological shock" of seeing a gray being, the small grey-skinned figure of abduction stories, in their bedroom, but over time many come to identify with the being. Michels passes this on as something said by John Mack, a psychiatrist who studied people reporting alien abductions, and he puts it to Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate in parapsychology, saying Mack went "one step deeper" on it with him. If so, the experience would reshape a person's sense of who they are, not just frighten them.
